# CareerPilot

> CareerPilot (https://careerpilot.website) is an AI-powered ATS Resume Screener, Executive LaTeX Resume Builder, Voice Mock Interviewer, CS Fundamentals Prep Hub, and Live Job Discovery platform designed for students, software engineers, and job seekers.

## Key Capabilities
- **AI ATS Resume Screener**: Upload PDF, DOCX, or TXT resumes against target Job Descriptions to receive a 0-100 ATS compatibility score, missing keyword diagnostics, and actionable career recommendations.
- **Executive LaTeX & Template Resume Builder**: Auto-parse existing resumes into clean, recruiter-approved ATS templates with real-time score feedback and AI bullet-point enhancement.
- **AI Voice & Written Mock Interviewer**: Practice resume-specific technical and behavioral interviews with real-time scoring across technical depth, clarity, and fluency.
- **Computer Science Special Hub & Full-Length Mock Tests**: Structured study guides for Operating Systems (OS), DBMS, Computer Networks (CN), OOPs, System Design, DSA patterns, and timed 5-section assessments.
- **Personalized Career Roadmaps & Live Job Aggregator**: Generate step-by-step skill roadmaps and search real-time listings across LinkedIn, Indeed, and Google Jobs.
